memories.description: All major combat pipelines proven end-to-end with real Conditions before API integration.
criteria: AttackChain + DamageChain with advantage/disadvantage, rage bonus, crits
MovementChain with DisengagingCondition prevents OA, Dash doubles movement
Turn lifecycle with temporary action cleanup
Full round with multiple characters and turn order
passing: Action economy flow: Attack ability -> Strike -> OffHandStrike
Two-weapon fighting: light weapon validation, grant flow
Event ordering: events published in correct sequence
Raging Barbarian vs Dodging Defender: AttackChain + DamageChain with real conditions
Disadvantage causes miss: DodgingCondition imposes disadvantage
Normal attack (no conditions): baseline without modifiers
Critical hit: natural 20 doubles dice, rage bonus
Turn end cleanup: temporary actions removed on Cleanup()
Disengaging prevents OA: DisengagingCondition -> MovementChain -> no OA
Normal movement triggers OA: goblin attacks when fighter leaves reach
Dash doubles movement: Dash ability grants speed as extra movement
not_implemented: Full round with multiple characters (turn order)
